Interpretation guardrails

  1. Pass means the frozen external verifier returned passed: true.
  2. Conditions were interleaved under a locked schedule. Tasks—not repetitions—are the inferential units.
  3. GPT-5.6 Sol is displayed as a reference anchor because its Codex path had uncontrolled sampling.
  4. Charts are descriptive views of the released S7 tables; they do not add experiments or change the analysis.
